title: Membership in a predicate-defined language
statement: Let $p$ be a predicate on finite binary strings and let $z$ be a finite binary string. Then $z$ belongs to the language consisting of strings satisfying $p$ if and only if $p(z)$ holds.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a predicate on finite binary strings
